intent: Подключить три независимые донат-платформы и настраиваемо создавать тыквы с суммой и сообщением доната, показывая ключевые слова кастомизации и их превью.
expectations: Автоматическая конвертация валют между платформой и валютой сцены не входит в объём.
Автоматическое объединение донатеров разных платформ по совпадающему имени не входит в объём.
Подключение нескольких аккаунтов одного провайдера в одной инсталляции не входит в объём.
Создание новых слотов и пользовательской графики кастомизации не входит в объём.
context: Существующий DonationService уже обрабатывает идентификаторы донатов, валюту, владельцев, рост тыкв и парсинг команды !тыковка.
Существующий словарь кастомизации предоставляет канонические значения и русские/английские алиасы для пяти визуальных слотов.
Публичные страницы документации указаны пользователем: DonationAlerts API, DonatEx API и Meme Alerts API; специфичные механизмы доставки подлежат проверке на этапе планирования.
Сохраняются серверная валидация, идемпотентность, изоляция секретов и независимость интеграций согласно конституции проекта.
approach: Use separate OAuth and reconnecting realtime adapters for DonationAlerts (Centrifugo), DonatEx (SignalR), and Meme Alerts (Centrifugo), normalizing events into the existing server-side donation engine. Persist provider-scoped idempotency and donor identity plus validated spawn rules in SQLite, while using the shared renderer for isolated admin previews.

decisions.decision: Use each provider documented outbound real-time transport rather than webhooks
decisions.why: All three official APIs document live event delivery and outbound connections fit the local app without a public listener
decisions.rejected: Webhook relay would add public ingress/tunnel and is not needed for the documented APIs

decisions.decision: Scope donation event IDs and new donor identity by provider
decisions.why: Provider event IDs and display names are not globally unique; scoping prevents duplicate suppression collisions and accidental cross-platform account merges
decisions.rejected: Global event IDs and name-based cross-platform matching are unsafe; preserve legacy DonationAlerts keys during migration

decisions.decision: Keep provider credentials in server configuration and OAuth tokens in the encrypted database
decisions.why: This follows the existing secret boundary and supports independent per-provider account connections
decisions.rejected: Browser-entered or browser-stored credentials would expose secrets

plan.summary: Completed a provider-specific architecture, SQLite migration and identity model, settings/UI design, lifecycle and normalized-event contracts, and credential-free validation guide.

tasks.summary: Generated 22 dependency-ordered, file-specific tasks: 1 setup, 1 shared schema foundation, 9 US1 provider integration, 4 US2 spawn settings and previews, 5 US3 donation processing, and 2 polish/validation; included per-story independent checks and parallel opportunities.

T001.did: Installed the documented Centrifugo 5 and SignalR client SDKs and updated package manifests.

T002.did: Added the provider-scoped donation key and spawn settings schema migrations while preserving legacy DonationAlerts donation and token records.

T004.did: Added server-side OAuth client configuration and example callback placeholders for all three donation providers, and hardened environment-file ignores.

T003.did: Added credential-free tests for independent provider status, OAuth scopes/state binding, normalized payloads, and Meme Alerts coin-currency isolation; confirmed the tests fail before provider functionality exists.

T005.did: Implemented provider-specific OAuth URL/callback/token refresh/logout, including DonatEx's required PKCE and documented token/profile endpoints.

T006.did: Implemented a Centrifugo SDK-backed realtime client with async connection/subscription token providers, bounded reconnects, sanitized status/errors, and injectable transport construction.

T007.did: Added DonationAlerts profile resolution, authenticated private-channel token retrieval, event normalization, and independent Centrifugo lifecycle.

T008.did: Added Meme Alerts profile fallback, refreshed private-channel token retrieval, event normalization, and its independent Centrifugo connection lifecycle.

T009.did: Added the DonatEx SignalR hub adapter with refreshed OAuth access tokens, bounded automatic reconnects, event normalization, and concurrent ID-based suppression for creation/rerun duplicates.

T010.did: Composed independent provider lifecycle management across OAuth routes, startup, logout and shutdown, forwarding normalized events to the donation service while exposing secret-free account statuses.

T011.did: Added separate DonationAlerts, DonatEx, and Meme Alerts cards with independent auth/live status, account display, local disconnect controls, and connection recovery guidance.

T012.did: Added failing-first HTTP, Socket.IO, and frontend contract tests for persisted spawn rules, validation, catalog aliases, and isolated previews.

T014.did: Exposed an immutable-by-contract catalog grouped by existing supported slots, with each canonical value and a copied list of its Russian and English aliases.

T013.did: Persisted and server-validated non-negative finite spawn thresholds and trimmed commands of at most 64 characters across the settings API and Socket.IO, returning the read-only customization catalog.

T015.did: Added persisted donation threshold/command controls and a grouped Russian/English alias catalog with detached shared-character previews that are destroyed on rerender and never mutate the scene.

T016.did: Added first-red engine tests covering spawn thresholds/commands, provider-scoped identity and event collisions, legacy DonationAlerts owner keys, existing-owner totals, currency mismatch, and unsafe positions.

T017.did: Made customization parsing recognize the normalized configured command as an exact case-insensitive message prefix, then parse only the remaining aliases.

T018.did: Namespaced new donor keys and donation event inserts per allow-listed provider while preserving existing DonationAlerts da:/name: key semantics and composite event uniqueness.

T020.did: Wired normalized callbacks from each transport to the shared DonationService and verified duplicate suppression, provider-scoped ID collisions, donor ownership, and customization through mocked server composition.

T021.did: Documented all donation OAuth settings and callbacks, independent statuses/recovery, provider-specific logout behavior, Meme Alerts approval, spawn threshold/command, currency rules, and offline test scope.

T019.did: Verified the normalized-event validator and authoritative donation pipeline enforce provider identity, event deduplication, currency, threshold, command, and safe-spawn rules while preserving updates to existing owners.

T022.did: Ran all offline quickstart checks; all 46 tests passed, backend syntax checks passed, and the admin browser module passed Node syntax validation. Updated the quickstart to use npm test on Windows and accurately describe the simulator's configured-command behavior.
